covered: five trigger types: keyword, tag_added, custom_field_set, api-event, EMIT_EVENT
subscriber-scoped triggers (one execution per subscriber per trigger fire)
telegram_user_id as primary external identifier; subscriberId as optional secondary (CYCLE-1 confirmed)
custom_field_set fires on any set/change, no value predicate v1
keyword: contains, case-insensitive, multiple keywords (any-of-many), separate List<String> field
keyword precedence: waiting_for_reply wins, keyword suppressed
fan-out via index relax (N separate funnels, same trigger) — no List<Trigger>
List<Trigger> / multi-entry deferred to Epic 8
loop protection: per-subscriber auto-enroll rate-limit 20/min, Redis fail-open, WARN log
Redis-independent depth-cap enroll-chain = 10 (added in round 2)
API key: lazy generation on demand, no auto-gen on project create, no backfill (CYCLE-2 revised)
plaintext shown once per (re)generation, hash-only in DB (SHA-256)
separate @Order(1) SecurityFilterChain for /api/integrations/**
namespace /api/integrations/v1/** (version inside namespace)
rate-limit on /events: fixed global ~300/min via Redis; fail-open semantics clarified
per-project/admin-editable limits deferred to Epic 08
event data payload NOT mapped to funnel variables in v1
regex keyword: nice-to-have, deferred
index migration: hand-rolled idempotent ApplicationRunner (FunnelStepIdBackfill pattern)
Mongock deferred as separate task
EMIT_EVENT: new StepType, subscriber-scoped, same event_name namespace as API events
internal dispatcher named FunnelEventService (not EventService — name collision)
unknown telegram_user_id → 404 (no auto-create subscriber)
idempotent tag add does NOT fire tag_added trigger
API key authorizes /api/integrations/** only; session does not authorize /api/integrations/**
error-isolation: trigger dispatches never throw outward (webhook 200 OK, API 202 on engine exception)
UI: trigger-type selector in FunnelTriggerSettings.vue (static badge → selector)
UI: trigger form built as portable component for future canvas migration (added in round 2)

summary: Усі п'ять знахідок раунду 1 (два critical, два major, один minor-YAML) усунуто. Документ не містить нетестовних критеріїв, відсутніх тем інтерв'ю чи суперечностей — статус змінено на approved.
